versions.content: The function GetCoreID shall return the unique logical CoreID of the core on which the function is called. The mapping of physical cores to logical Core IDs is implementation specific.

Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80001 The function GetCoreID shall return the unique logical CoreID of the core on which the function is called. The value is defined in the configuration parameter EcucCoreId.
